newsitem.title: CHINA: Largest Sino-foreign power project breaks ground.
newsitem.headline: Largest Sino-foreign power project breaks ground.

text.p: China's largest Sino-foreign joint venture power project has broken ground, the official Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report.
Germany's Siemens AG, with an investment of $502.7 million, has a 40 percent stake in the Hebei Hanfeng power plant project in Handan city in the northern province of Hebei, Xinhua said.
The Chinese partners are North China Power Group Co and two provincial companies, it said.
The plant, with an installed capacity of 2,400 megawatts, would begin operation in September 2000, a spokesman for the joint venture said.
It would greatly alleviate the power shortage in the southern part of Hebei, he said.
